metadata.description: Regional market baselines for Indian residential lease agreements
metadata.source: Aggregated from NoBroker, MagicBricks, and 99acres market reports
metadata.disclaimer: These are statistical averages for informational comparison only.

Security Deposit.notes: South Indian metros typically require 10 months; North Indian metros typically require 2-3 months.

Lock-in Period.notes: Lock-in beyond 3 months is uncommon in standard 11-month agreements.

Notice Period.notes: Mutual notice period is market standard.

Maintenance Liability.high_threshold: Tenant responsible for ALL repairs regardless of nature
Maintenance Liability.notes: Standard practice divides responsibility by repair type.

Rent Escalation.notes: Escalation applies on lease renewal, not during the initial term.

Subletting.notes: Most standard leases prohibit subletting without owner consent.

Termination.standard_range: Either party may terminate with 1-2 months notice
Termination.high_threshold: Owner-only termination rights or immediate eviction clauses
Termination.notes: Balanced termination rights are market standard.

Painting & Restoration Charges.standard_range: Painting at tenant cost if walls are damaged
Painting & Restoration Charges.high_threshold: Full painting mandatory regardless of condition
Painting & Restoration Charges.notes: Full mandatory painting on exit regardless of wall condition is above market standard.

Utilities & Common Area.standard_value: Tenant pays utility bills; owner pays society maintenance
Utilities & Common Area.high_threshold: Tenant pays all charges including society maintenance
Utilities & Common Area.notes: Standard practice separates utility and society charges.

Security Deposit.notes: Bangalore uniquely maintains very high deposit standards.
